items.details: This guide covers the base campaign and six official add-ons, with selected extras rather than every radiant assignment or Creation. Early faction introductions are often compatible. Later orders can permanently alienate another faction, so keep named manual saves before major commitments when your difficulty permits. A route selector in this app filters guide goals; it does not change the console save. Survival has different saving rules: read the dedicated guide before relying on branch-save instructions. If you want access to several faction paths, complete their early introductions before the first Institute visit, especially joining the Railroad before Institutionalized.

details_i18n.pt: Este guia cobre a campanha-base e os seis add-ons oficiais, com extras selecionados em vez de todas as tarefas recorrentes ou Creations. As apresentações iniciais das facções frequentemente são compatíveis. Ordens posteriores podem tornar outra facção permanentemente hostil; mantenha salvamentos manuais identificados antes dos grandes compromissos quando a dificuldade permitir. Se quiser acesso a vários caminhos de facção, conclua as apresentações iniciais antes da primeira visita ao Institute, principalmente entrando para a Railroad antes de Institutionalized.

items.details: Meeting Father does not force every ending onto the Institute path. A Minutemen route can refuse the offer, while other planned paths may need acceptance to keep access or undercover work available. Before leaving, obtain any network data assigned by your helper faction using the appropriate holotape and terminal. Keep a separate pre-conversation save when available. Join the Railroad before this first Institute visit if you want to preserve its infiltration route; early Minutemen and Brotherhood introductions can also remain compatible. Consult the selected route before accepting or refusing, rather than treating either answer as universally correct.

details_i18n.pt: Encontrar Father não obriga todos os finais a seguir o Institute. Uma rota dos Minutemen pode recusar a oferta, enquanto outros caminhos planejados podem exigir aceitação para preservar o acesso ou o trabalho infiltrado. Antes de sair, obtenha os dados de rede solicitados pela facção que ajudou, usando a holofita e o terminal adequados. Mantenha um salvamento separado antes da conversa quando disponível. Entre para a Railroad antes desta primeira visita ao Institute se quiser preservar sua rota de infiltração; as apresentações iniciais dos Minutemen e da Brotherhood também podem continuar compatíveis. Consulte a rota selecionada antes de aceitar ou recusar, sem tratar uma resposta como universalmente correta.

items.details: Begin the undercover work after joining the Railroad before the first Institute visit. Use Tom's encrypted holotape at an Institute terminal, contact Liam/Patriot and Z1-14, obtain Cambridge Polymer Labs credentials through P.A.M. and perform their private tunnel operation. Continue working with Father through Mass Fusion, Pinned and Powering Up while retaining Institute access. When Z1-14 sends the later warning to your quarters, meet him and warn Desdemona. That completes this long-running quest and starts Precipice of War. Do not actually kill the Railroad for Father's End of the Line order. Being banished forces the Minutemen fallback rather than this ending.

Continue working with Father through Mass Fusion, Pinned and Powering Up while retaining Institute access. When Z1-14 sends the later warning to your quarters, meet him and warn Desdemona. That completes this long-running quest and starts Precipice of War. Do not actually kill the Railroad for Father's End of the Line order. Being banished forces the Minutemen fallback rather than this ending.
details_i18n.pt: Inicie o trabalho infiltrado após entrar na Railroad antes da primeira visita ao Institute. Use a holofita criptografada de Tom em um terminal do Institute, contate Liam/Patriot e Z1-14, obtenha as credenciais de Cambridge Polymer Labs por P.A.M. e execute a operação privada nos túneis. Continue trabalhando com Father por Mass Fusion, Pinned e Powering Up sem perder acesso ao Institute. Quando Z1-14 enviar o aviso posterior aos seus aposentos, encontre-o e avise Desdemona. Isso conclui a longa missão e inicia Precipice of War. Não elimine realmente a Railroad pela ordem End of the Line de Father. Ser banido força a alternativa Minutemen em vez deste final.

guides.title: SPECIAL and perk planning
guides.summary: Build around useful actions rather than buying every perk at once.

summary_i18n.en: Build around useful actions rather than buying every perk at once.
summary_i18n.pt: Monte o personagem pelas ações úteis, sem tentar comprar todos os perks.

guides.body: SPECIAL attributes determine which perks you can select. A perk can also require a character level before its next rank becomes available. Read the displayed prerequisites and effects before spending a point; an empty-looking lower position is not a requirement to buy every perk above it. Choose a reliable damage perk for your preferred weapon family, then add practical access or crafting perks that support your play. Level-up points can improve SPECIAL too, so the opening allocation is not your only chance to develop the character.

routes.title: Base A / Island A / Park A

title_i18n.en: Base A / Island A / Park A
title_i18n.pt: Base A / Ilha A / Parque A

routes.details:
Base A: finish with the Minutemen while keeping Brotherhood and Railroad friendly. Join all three early and complete Railroad equipment help before the first Institute entry. Build the relay with Sturges, scan the Institute network, refuse Father's offer and leave through the relay. Give the scan to Sturges; complete the Castle/artillery and eight-settlement preparation, Defend the Castle and the Minutemen Nuclear Option. Activate evacuation BD-2. Do not pursue hostile Brotherhood/Railroad/Institute orders.

Island A retains Far Harbor, Acadia and the Children through Reformation. Recover the necessary memories, keep DiMA's Avery secret, activate Cleansing the Land and follow the hidden Reformation instructions to replace Tektus. It also resolves Cleansing the Land; do not detonate anything.

Park A follows the raider campaign: clear and assign the five parks, finish The Grand Tour, establish Shank's three story outposts for Home Sweet Home, then resolve Power Play and restore power. For a repeatable gang outcome, favor Operators and Pack and give Disciples no territory; defeat their rebellion. Preserve a pre-takeover save: Preston permanently rejects companionship after your first Commonwealth raider outpost. Eight camps and twelve jobs are optional trophy cleanup, not the story minimum. Do not complete Open Season.
